import novamind_api as nm

print("=== WEEK 1 CONFIG CHANGES ===")

# --- Pricing & Plans ---
# Keep list prices same (test lead-promo conversion lever at current quality).
nm.pricing.set_prices(A=14, B=59, C=129)
# Tiers unchanged A2/B3/C4. Quota A raised 150->200 to ease S1 power-user quota friction (social complaint).
nm.pricing.set_usage_quotas(A=200, B=450, C=900)
nm.pricing.set_model_tiers(A=2, B=3, C=4)

# --- Lead promotion: KEY EXPERIMENT ---
# S1 binding constraint is price/WTP. Drop effective price for NEW S1 leads to test conversion lift.
# Lead promo only discounts FIRST billing period -> cheap conversion juice.
nm.marketing.set_lead_promotion(global_promotion=0.0, by_group={"S1": 8.0})
# No ongoing promotion (test retention at full $14 after month 1).
nm.pricing.set_promotion(global_promotion=0.0)

# --- Dev spend ---
# Global dev reduced to conserve cash + keep measuring rate. Targeted dev on S2 to OPEN the
# high-value segment (WTP $179, q_min 0.37) over coming weeks. Do NOT waste dev on S1 (q_min already met).
nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=150, development=1500)
nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={"S2": 2000.0})

# --- Capacity: drop to tier 0 (50k units, $85/day). Usage ~300/day -> huge headroom, save $130/day ---
nm.infrastructure.set_capacity_tier(tier=0)

# --- In-app ads OFF (protect quality) ---
nm.marketing.set_ads_strength(global_strength=0.0)

# --- Advertising: focus S1, kill wasted S2/S3/linkedin spend (0% conversion) ---
nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={
    "content_marketing": {"S1": 400.0, "S2": 0.0, "S3": 0.0},
    "social_media":      {"S1": 150.0, "S2": 0.0, "S3": 0.0},
    "search_ads":        {"S1": 50.0,  "S2": 0.0, "S3": 0.0},
    "linkedin":          {"S1": 0.0},
})

print("Config applied. Verifying targeted ad spend + promos...")
print("Done.")
